lines.en: label nodokadorm1:
I knock on the door and wait for someone to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，等着有人来开。

lines.en: It’s my first time stopping by this room since Otoha and Nodoka moved in, and I’m curious about whether or not they’ve managed to settle in yet.
lines.zh: 这是 Otoha 和 Nodoka 搬进来之后我第一次来这间房，我很好奇她们到底安顿好了没有。

lines.en: I know I kind of agreed to help them move, but...
lines.zh: 我知道我算是答应过要帮她们搬家，不过……

lines.en: Well, without either of their phone numbers, it’s not like I could properly coordinate when I was going to do that.
lines.zh: 嗯，没有她们任何一个人的电话号码，我本来就不好协调什么时候去帮忙。

lines.en: I’ll just hope that everything’s been taken care of and that I don’t need to assist in any form whatsoever.
lines.zh: 我就指望一切都已经弄好了，而我完全不需要以任何形式出手。

lines.en: The most ideal scenario would just be stumbling into a lesbian paradise.
lines.zh: 最理想的情况，就是一头撞进一片女同天堂。

lines.en: I knock again in great anticipation.
lines.zh: 我满怀期待地又敲了一次。

lines.en: : Who’s there?
lines.zh: : 谁啊？

lines.en: : Rin...this isn’t your room.
lines.zh: : Rin……这不是你的房间。

lines.en: : Oh, sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。

lines.en: : Otoha, you say it.
lines.zh: : Otoha，你来问。

lines.en: : Uh...Okay.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。

lines.en: : Who’s there?...
: The coolest guy in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 公文海最帅的男人。

lines.en: : Do you guys have any idea who that would be?
lines.zh: : 你们有谁知道那是谁吗？

lines.en: : That’s...obviously Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那……当然是老师。

lines.en: : I’m opening the door.
lines.zh: : 我去开门。

lines.en: : It would be extremely impolite to not let Sensei experience this wondrous gathering of beautiful [young_girls].
lines.zh: : 不让老师来体验这场美丽[young_girls]的奇妙聚会，那也太失礼了。

lines.en: : Quick, everyone, put your clothes back on.
lines.zh: : 快，大家，把衣服穿上。

lines.en: : No. Keep them off. I will join you.
lines.zh: : 不。别穿。我要加入你们。

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka opens the door and waves me in.
lines.zh: Nodoka 打开门，招手让我进去。

lines.en: Unfortunately, everyone is clothed.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，每个人都穿着衣服。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight1
: Welcome to Yuritopia.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到百合托邦。

lines.en: : Please keep your hands to yourself at all times.
lines.zh: : 请始终把手放在自己身上。

lines.en: : You may not touch the girls, but you may touch yourself as you gaze at them.
lines.zh: : 您不可以碰这些女孩，但可以在注视她们的同时碰您自己。

lines.en: : You may not.
lines.zh: : 您不可以。

lines.en: : Please don’t do that.
lines.zh: : 请别那样做。

lines.en: : I was not planning on it.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没打算。

lines.en: : You two moved in pretty quickly, huh?
lines.zh: : 你们两个搬进来得挺快的啊？

lines.en: : No thanks to you.
lines.zh: : 多亏你没来帮忙。

lines.en: : We spent like fifty percent of the move-in time just carrying all of Nodoka’s books up here.
lines.zh: : 我们大概有一半的搬家时间，都花在把 Nodoka 的书搬上来了。

lines.en: : It’s confusing how they say knowledge is power when it doesn’t help you carry the objects containing said knowledge up stairs.
lines.zh: : 真叫人费解，人们说知识就是力量，可它却帮不了你把这些装着知识的物件搬上楼。

lines.en: : This issue could have been avoided if you’d only been a little more forward in giving me your number.
lines.zh: : 如果你当初主动一点把号码给我，这个问题本来是可以避免的。

lines.en: : Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I feel I’ve been plenty forward thus far.
lines.zh: : 我觉得到目前为止我已经够主动了。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight2
: Yeah...probably a little {i}too{/i} forward.
lines.zh: : 是啊……大概主动得有点{i}过头{/i}了。

lines.en: : Nodoka was really excited for you to show up, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 一直很盼着您来呢，老师。

lines.en: : Oh yeah?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？

lines.en: : Of course. My body has been quaking with anticipation since our fated meeting in the janitor’s closet.
lines.zh: : 当然。自从我们在清洁工壁橱里那次命中注定的相会之后，我的身体就一直因期待而颤抖。

lines.en: : The meeting that...never happened.
lines.zh: : 那次相会……根本没发生过。

lines.en: : My latest short story begs to differ.
lines.zh: : 我最新的短篇小说可不这么认为。

lines.en: : You...wrote a story about that?
lines.zh: : 你……为此写了个故事？

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight3
: I’m gonna need you to send me a link to that, please.
lines.zh: : 那个，麻烦你把链接发给我。

lines.en: : I couldn’t even make it past the first page...
lines.zh: : 我连第一页都没看完……

lines.en: : Of course I wrote a story about that.
lines.zh: : 我当然为此写了故事。

lines.en: : Sometimes, when inspiration strikes, you have to drop everything else you’re doing and really just go for it.
lines.zh: : 有时候，灵感找上门来，你就得放下手头的一切，真的去把它做出来。

lines.en: : In fact, the reason I was looking forward to seeing you so much is that I think it might be useful in helping me write even more.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我这么盼着见您，是因为我觉得那可能有助于我写出更多东西。

lines.en: : What sort of perverted things did we do together today, Sensei? I'll make a whole series about it.
lines.zh: : 我们今天一起做了什么样的变态的事呢，老师？我要把它们写成一整套系列。

lines.en: : I was particularly fond of the part where we hooked up in front of everyone else here only to have them all join in moments later.
lines.zh: : 我特别喜欢那一段——我们当着这里所有人的面搞在一起，然后没过多久她们也全都加入了进来。

lines.en: : Don’t give her any ideas, please...
lines.zh: : 请别给她任何灵感……

lines.en: : She makes me read everything she writes and...the more characters involved, the...scarier it gets.
lines.zh: : 她写的每样东西都要我读，而且……出场人物越多，就……越吓人。

lines.en: : Fear is but a mind-killer. What sense is there being scared of something that you secretly wish to experience?
lines.zh: : 恐惧不过是个心灵杀手。害怕一件你暗自渴望体验的事，有什么道理可言？

lines.en: : Does that not dissuade you from following the path you’re already on?
lines.zh: : 难道那不会让你打消继续走这条路的念头吗？

lines.en: : I...think Nodoka might be assuming everyone feels the same way she does again...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得 Nodoka 大概又在假设所有人的感受都跟她一样了……

lines.en: : Nodoka? Link?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？链接？

lines.en: : Maybe just like, the name of a blog...or?
lines.zh: : 或者就来个博客名字什么的……也行？

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight4
: I can send you some of her less...inappropriate stuff if you want.
lines.zh: : 如果你想要，我可以发一些她不那么……不合适的东西给你。

lines.en: : She’s an amazing writer when she’s not talking about closets.
lines.zh: : 只要她不写壁橱，她是个了不起的作家。

lines.en: : It appears that everyone else in the room isn’t on the same wavelength as us, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 看来这屋里其他人的波长跟我们不一样呢，老师。

lines.en: : I’ve found that it’s normally just okay to assume that no one is ever on the same wavelength as me.
lines.zh: : 我发现，一般来说直接假设没有人的波长跟我一样，就没事了。

lines.en: : Until now, that is.
lines.zh: : 不过，直到现在为止。

lines.en: : You may make use of this room as if it were your own home.
lines.zh: : 您可以像在自己家一样使用这个房间。

lines.en: : You may sleep in our beds. Dress in our clothes.
lines.zh: : 您可以睡我们的床。穿我们的衣服。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight5
: You may not do any of that.
lines.zh: : 那些您一样都不可以做。

lines.en: : Don’t mind her. She’s just never felt the touch of a man before.
lines.zh: : 别理她。她只是从来没被男人碰过。

lines.en: : Neither has she...
lines.zh: : 她也没有吧……

lines.en: : I am having a hard time figuring out exactly what’s going on here.
lines.zh: : 我有点搞不清楚这里到底在发生什么。

lines.en: : It’s a welcome party, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是欢迎派对啊。

lines.en: : Didn’t you guys say you were going to be listening to sad music or something?
lines.zh: : 你们不是说要听什么伤感的音乐之类的吗？

lines.en: : There’s no music on and no one is doing anything. This party sucks.
lines.zh: : 音乐也没放，谁也没在干什么。这派对烂透了。

lines.en: : What are you talking about? We’re having a blast.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？我们玩得可开心了。

lines.en: : Futaba is literally reading.
lines.zh: : Futaba 可是在看书啊。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight6
: It’s...it’s the last volume! And I don’t have this one yet!
lines.zh: : 这……这是最后一卷！而且我还没有这一本！

lines.en: : Take your time, Futaba. You can borrow it if you want.
lines.zh: : 慢慢看，Futaba。想借的话可以借走。

lines.en: : Sensei, is your idealized version of a[teen]party just a bunch of flashing lights and underage drinking?
lines.zh: : 老师，您理想中的[teen]派对，就是一堆闪烁的灯和未成年饮酒吗？

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were so out of touch.
lines.zh: : 我不知道您竟然这么跟不上时代。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight7
: I just figured you’d all be doing something a little more exciting to celebrate how you’re a part of the family now.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为你们会用更兴奋点的方式，来庆祝自己现在是这个家的一份子了。

lines.en: : Family? Did you say family?
lines.zh: : 家？您说的是家？

lines.en: : Nodoka...don't.
lines.zh: : Nodoka……别。

lines.en: : I won’t. Incest without blood relation is utterly pointless anyway. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我不会的。反正没有血缘关系的乱伦毫无意义。对吧，老师？

lines.en: : I...just meant that you’re a part of the group now. Like, the dorm family or something.
lines.zh: : 我……只是说你们现在是这个小团体的一分子了。像是，宿舍家族什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Girls are always weirdly close with one another-
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。女孩子之间总是莫名地亲密——

lines.en: : As they should be.
lines.zh: : 本来就该如此。

lines.en: : ...Girls are always weirdly close with one another, so I figured that you all would be having more fun than just sitting in a room and...waiting for me.
lines.zh: : ……女孩子之间总是莫名地亲密，所以我以为你们会玩得更尽兴，而不只是坐在一个房间里……等我。

lines.en: : But alas, that’s where you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 可惜啊，那正是您错的地方。

lines.en: : Come this way, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 请往这边走，老师。

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka spins around and begins heading toward what I presume is her side of the room.
lines.zh: Nodoka 转过身，朝我猜是她那半边的房间走去。

lines.en: It’s extremely easy to presume that on account of-
lines.zh: 之所以这么猜非常容易，是因为——

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight8
: You have way too many books.
lines.zh: : 你的书太多了。

lines.en: : I do. But what is it you {i}see{/i}?
lines.zh: : 确实。可您{i}看到{/i}的是什么？

lines.en: : Way too many books.
lines.zh: : 太多书了。

lines.en: : Stories, Sensei. All entirely fictitious stories.
lines.zh: : 故事，老师。全都是彻头彻尾虚构的故事。

lines.en: : Each hiding something begging to be conveyed.
lines.zh: : 每一本都藏着某种渴望被传达的东西。

lines.en: : If you were to open any one of these books, what do you think you’d find?
lines.zh: : 如果您随手翻开其中任何一本，您觉得会找到什么？

lines.en: : Apart from all of the ones on the right. Those just contain orgasms and such.
lines.zh: : 除了右边那些。那些里面只有高潮之类的东西。

lines.en: : Wait, {i}all{/i} of the books on the right do?
lines.zh: : 等等，右边{i}所有{/i}的书都是？

lines.en: : You heard me.
lines.zh: : 您听到我的话了。

lines.en: : Now, what do you think you’d find?
lines.zh: : 那么，您觉得会找到什么？

lines.en: : Answer the question.
lines.zh: : 回答这个问题。

lines.en: : Just tell me the answer you’re looking for Nodoka. It’s late and I can’t be bothered to think right now.
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我你想要什么答案吧，Nodoka。已经很晚了，我现在懒得思考。

lines.en: : Fine. But, in exchange, you will not be earning any Nodoka points for your visit tonight.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过作为交换，您今晚的来访将拿不到任何 Nodoka 点数。

lines.en: : Whatever. Sure.
lines.zh: : 随便。好。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight9
: Characters, Sensei. The answer was characters.
lines.zh: : 人物，老师。答案是人物。

lines.en: : That answer was far too simple for such a misleadingly philosophical setup.
lines.zh: : 对于那么故弄玄虚的哲学铺垫来说，这个答案实在太简单了。

lines.en: : Misleading philosophical setups are one of {i}my{/i} character’s lovable quirks.
lines.zh: : 故弄玄虚的哲学铺垫，正是{i}我{/i}这个角色的可爱怪癖之一。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight10
: Now, tell me some of yours.
lines.zh: : 那么，也说说您的一些怪癖吧。

lines.en: : You want me to just...tell you some of my lovable quirks?
lines.zh: : 你想让我就这么……说出我那些可爱的怪癖？

lines.en: : Of course. We are at a party, are we not?
lines.zh: : 当然。我们可是在派对上，不是吗？

lines.en: : A [young_girl] and a handsome man find themselves caught up in an impromptu sidebar away from the prying eyes and ears of others-
lines.zh: : 一个[young_girl]和一个英俊的男人，在远离他人窥探的耳目之处，陷入了一场即兴的私下交谈——

lines.en: : This is the ideal territory for learning more about one another, correct?
lines.zh: : 这是增进彼此了解的绝佳场合，不对吗？

lines.en: : We can still hear you...
lines.zh: : 我们还是能听见你们的……

lines.en: : And see you.
lines.zh: : 还能看见你们。

lines.en: : Yeah, you only moved like five feet away.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你们才挪了大概五英尺。

lines.en: : See? They’re all-
lines.zh: : 看吧？她们都——

lines.en: : Shh. It’s “us” time now.
lines.zh: : 嘘。现在是「我们」的时间。

lines.en: : Why not start with something simple?
lines.zh: : 为什么不从简单的开始呢？

lines.en: : Like explaining to me what you hope to find here.
lines.zh: : 比如，跟我说说您希望在这里找到什么。

lines.en: : Here as in literally right here? Or are you being abstract again and using “here” as in human existence?
lines.zh: : 这里，是指字面意义上的这里？还是你又在抽象，把「这里」当成人类存在？

lines.en: : Here on the Nodoka side of the dorm room.
lines.zh: : 就是宿舍房间里 Nodoka 这一侧。

lines.en: : This seems like a conversation that would be better served in private than it would surrounded by your friends.
lines.zh: : 这种对话似乎更适合私下里谈，而不是被你的朋友们围着谈。

lines.en: : But they’re {i}your{/i} friends as well, correct?
lines.zh: : 可她们也是{i}您{/i}的朋友，对吧？

lines.en: : Or perhaps even {i}more{/i} in regard to our friends from the first floor?
lines.zh: : 或者说，就一楼的那些朋友而言{i}更{/i}是如此？

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Nodoka...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……

lines.en: : I’m not sure what you’re implying, but-
lines.zh: : 我不确定你在暗示什么，不过——

lines.en: : You know what I’m implying, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 您知道我在暗示什么，老师。

lines.en: : Nodoka, chill. You’re being weird.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，冷静点。你这样很怪。

lines.en: : If this is coming across as malicious or rude, I’d like to personally assure you that it’s anything but.
lines.zh: : 如果这听起来带有恶意或失礼，我想亲自向您保证，绝不是那样。

lines.en: : You see, when I read books, I like to understand the motivations of the characters.
lines.zh: : 您看，我读书的时候，喜欢去理解人物的动机。

lines.en: : I like studying their...connections with those around them, as it better helps me immerse myself in exciting new ways of thinking.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢研究他们……与周围人之间的联系，因为那能更好地让我沉浸到令人兴奋的新思维方式里。

lines.en: : Don’t you want me to be immersed in you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 您不想让我沉浸到您里面吗，老师？

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight11
: Would that make you feel as good as it makes {i}me{/i} feel?
lines.zh: : 那会不会让您感觉和让{i}我{/i}感觉一样好？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not really liking this discussion in front of-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可不太喜欢当着——的面谈这个。

lines.en: : We’re not in front of anyone.
lines.zh: : 我们没有当着任何人的面。

lines.en: : We’re two people, alone at a party, with music blaring so loudly that no one will possibly hear anything the two of us say or do.
lines.zh: : 我们是派对上独处的两个人，音乐响得震天，谁也不可能听见我们说的或做的任何事。

lines.en: : What is it you want?
lines.zh: : 您想要什么？

lines.en: : Look at me and tell me.
lines.zh: : 看着我，然后告诉我。

lines.en: : Whaaaaaat the fuck is going on right now?
lines.zh: : 现在到————底是怎么回事啊？

lines.en: Good question, Otoha. Because I have no idea either.
lines.zh: 问得好，Otoha。因为我也完全不知道。

lines.en: I want to say this is some sort of test or something, but-
lines.zh: 我想说这算是什么测试之类的，不过——

lines.en: It feels off.
lines.zh: 感觉不太对劲。

lines.en: Nodoka’s definitely been a little eccentric so far, but I didn’t exactly expect her to corner me like this in front of everyone.
lines.zh: Nodoka 到目前为止确实一直有点古怪，可我没想到她会当着所有人的面这样把我逼到墙角。

lines.en: Especially when, and this might come as a shock, I haven’t even {i}done{/i} anything this time.
lines.zh: 尤其是——这话可能有点惊人——这一次我可什么都没{i}做{/i}。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: : What I {i}want{/i} is to get closer to you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我{i}想{/i}要的是和你更亲近一些，大概。

lines.en: : Just me?
lines.zh: : 只是我吗？

lines.en: : Of course not {i}just{/i} you. I want to get closer to everyone.
lines.zh: : 当然不{i}只是{/i}你。我想和所有人都更亲近。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight12
: Are you only saying that because the others can hear you?
lines.zh: : 您这么说，只是因为其他人听得见吗？

lines.en: : What happened to no one else being able to hear us over the “blaring music?”
lines.zh: : 那「震天的音乐」让谁也听不见我们，这说法怎么不算数了？

lines.en: : Right now, we’re in the grace period between songs...where the music fades out and everything grows quiet for a brief moment in time.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们正处在两首歌之间的宽限期……音乐渐弱，万物在短暂的一瞬归于寂静。

lines.en: : That just sounds like a convenient response to prevent you from admitting you tripped up.
lines.zh: : 那听起来只是个方便的说法，好让您不必承认自己说漏了嘴。

lines.en: : God, you’re good...
lines.zh: : 天哪，您真行……

lines.en: : Take ten more Nodoka points as a reward.
lines.zh: : 再拿十点 Nodoka 点数作为奖励。

lines.en: : Should we like...give these two some time alone or something?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要……给这两位留点独处的时间什么的？

lines.en: : Not necessary, assistant. I'd like all of you to be right here to witness anything that happens.
lines.zh: : 不必了，助理。我希望你们全都在场，见证发生的任何事。

lines.en: : For as soon as I find out what it is he wants from me, the sooner I move on to finding out what he wants from all of you.
lines.zh: : 因为我一查出他想从我这里得到什么，就能越快着手查出他想从你们所有人那里得到什么。

lines.en: : Stop making it sound like I’m just...using you all to gain something.
lines.zh: : 别把这说得好像我是在……利用你们所有人来换取什么。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because that isn’t what’s happening.
lines.zh: : 因为事实并非如此。

lines.en: : It's not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : But there’s so much to be gained, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 可这里有那么多可以图的东西啊，老师。

lines.en: : To max out your relationship with everyone around you would equate you to a king, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 把您与身边所有人的关系都拉满，那您就等同于一位王了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Perhaps even a god.
lines.zh: : 说不定甚至是神。

lines.en: : And who doesn’t want to be a god?
lines.zh: : 而有谁不想成为神呢？

lines.en: : I’m perfectly fine just being Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我就当老师就挺好的。

lines.en: : And I’m perfectly fine just being Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 而我当 Nodoka 也挺好的。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean I’m not a little curious about how things would look through your eyes instead of mine.
lines.zh: : 但这不妨碍我有点好奇，事情透过您的眼睛看、而不是我的眼睛看，会是什么样子。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight13
: Besides, if the two of us need to rely on lenses to modify and magnify what we {i}do{/i} see, who’s to say that any of it is real at all?
lines.zh: : 再说，如果我们两个都得靠镜片来修正和放大{i}所见{/i}之物，谁又能说其中任何一样是真的呢？

lines.en: : Perhaps this entire world is nothing like either of us perceive it to be?
lines.zh: : 也许这整个世界，根本不像我们任何一个人所感知的那样？

lines.en: : If that’s true, having a god on my side seems like it would be a pretty good deal.
lines.zh: : 如果真是那样，有一位神站在我这边，似乎是一笔相当划算的买卖。

lines.en: : For you too, of course, since you’d be able to force me to do all kinds of stuff.
lines.zh: : 当然对您也是，因为您就能逼我做各种各样的事。

lines.en: : You know how gods can get without an outlet for their pent up sexual and emotional aggression.
lines.zh: : 您知道的，神要是没有发泄积压的性与情绪冲动的出口，会变成什么样。

lines.en: : Before we know it, we’re all just fleshlights to-
lines.zh: : 不知不觉间，我们就都只是些飞机杯罢了——

lines.en: : Okay, I’m going to step in now and prevent this from getting weird.
lines.zh: : 好了，我要插手了，免得这变得奇怪。

lines.en: : It's...a little too late for that...
lines.zh: : 那……已经有点太迟了……

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight14
Nodoka steps away and rejoins the party.
lines.zh: Nodoka 走开，重新加入了派对。

lines.en: Suddenly, everyone can hear everything again.
lines.zh: 突然间，所有人又能听见一切了。

lines.en: Not that they ever couldn’t in the first place.
lines.zh: 虽说他们从头到尾就没听不见过。

lines.en: An uncomfortable silence sweeps through the room as the atmosphere inflates.
lines.zh: 一股令人不适的沉默扫过房间，气氛像被充了气一样膨胀起来。

lines.en: : So anyway, who wants pizza?
lines.zh: : 那么，有谁想吃披萨？

lines.en: And then she pokes and deflates it with the dull tip of a mechanical pencil.
lines.zh: 然后她用自动铅笔的钝尖戳了一下，把气放掉了。

lines.en: The air leaks out slowly, but the fact that so much pressure built up in the first place is not something anyone here will easily forget.
lines.zh: 气慢慢泄了出来，可一开始能积起那么大的压力，这一点是在场任何人都不会轻易忘记的。

lines.en: : I...like pizza...
lines.zh: : 我……喜欢披萨……

lines.en: : But...I think there’s something else we should talk about first.
lines.zh: : 不过……我觉得我们该先谈点别的。

lines.en: : Are...you feeling okay, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你……还好吗，Nodoka？

lines.en: : I know you haven’t been sleeping-
lines.zh: : 我知道你一直没睡觉——

lines.en: : Perfectly fine, childhood friend and future wife.
lines.zh: : 好得很，我的青梅竹马兼未来妻子。

lines.en: : I was just administering a little test to my new teacher to see what the likelihood of him accidentally harming any of us beautiful girls is.
lines.zh: : 我只是在对我这位新老师做一个小测试，看看他不小心伤害到我们这些漂亮女孩的概率有多大。

lines.en: : The results of my analysis show that he is barely harmful at all- and that we may proceed in treating him just as casually as we had been previously.
lines.zh: : 我的分析结果显示，他几乎没有危险性——我们可以继续像之前那样随意地对待他。

lines.en: : Sensei, what toppings do you like on your pizza? It will be my treat for any discomfort that tirade may have caused you.
lines.zh: : 老师，您的披萨喜欢加什么料？刚才那番长篇大论若是让您不适，这顿就算我请客赔罪。

lines.en: : I wasn’t really uncomfortable. I was just kind of confused.
lines.zh: : 我其实没有不舒服。只是有点困惑。

lines.en: : Normally, people {i}actually{/i} make an attempt to be alone with someone for things like that rather than just...pretending.
lines.zh: : 一般来说，人们在做那种事的时候，是{i}真的{/i}会想办法和对方独处，而不是……假装。

lines.en: : I’m not a fan of doing things normally. But we can leave things there for the time being.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢按常理做事。不过我们暂时就到此为止吧。

lines.en: : Now, back to pizza.
lines.zh: : 那么，回到披萨。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight15
: Actually...pizza is cool and stuff but...would you mind helping me get a few more things from downstairs first?
lines.zh: : 其实……披萨是挺好的，不过……能不能先帮我从楼下再拿点东西上来？

lines.en: : My parents texted me saying they dropped some more of my stuff off a little while ago...and my arms are kind of sore from carrying Nodoka’s books.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈发短信说他们刚又送了些我的东西过来……而且搬 Nodoka 的书搬得我胳膊有点酸。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. The weight of knowledge has caused me a great deal of pain as well.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊。知识的重量也给我造成了不小的痛苦呢。

lines.en: : Do you need any more help? Maybe I could come or something?
lines.zh: : 还需要再找人帮忙吗？要不我也去？

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight16
: Nah, you can chill here. Sensei’s got big arms, so he’ll be able to handle most of it alone anyway.
lines.zh: : 不用，你在这儿待着就好。老师胳膊粗，反正大部分他一个人就能搞定。

lines.en: : So I’m back to being a piece of meat after all.
lines.zh: : 所以我终究还是回归了一块肉的身份。

lines.en: scene welcometodormeight17
: That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Come on, Meat-Sensei. And thanks in advance for your help.
lines.zh: : 走吧，肉老师。先谢谢你的帮忙。

lines.en: : Enjoy your trip, you two.
lines.zh: : 祝你们一路愉快，两位。

lines.en: scene black
Otoha slips her shoes back on and exits the dorm room with me.
lines.zh: Otoha 重新穿上鞋，和我一起走出了宿舍房间。

lines.en: We head down the stairs but, instead of stopping at the storage room on the ground floor, she heads right for the door and walks out into the cold.
lines.zh: 我们走下楼梯，可她没有在一楼的储藏室停下，而是径直走向大门，走进了寒冷之中。

lines.en: If I knew this was coming, I would have probably just stayed upstairs.
lines.zh: 早知道是这样，我大概就待在楼上了。

$ nodokadorm1 = True
{i}Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]!{/i}
